audience: marketers who run referral campaigns for their brands on Referrals.com

useCases.title: Compare how campaigns performed
useCases.text: List the campaigns, then read the stats of one campaign: participants, shares, clicks, impressions and daily signups.

useCases.title: Check the stats of a brand
useCases.text: Read one brand with its analytics: campaigns, participants, shares, clicks and impressions.

useCases.title: Find who joined a campaign and who invited them
useCases.text: List the participants of a campaign. Open one participant to read their shares, rewards and the emails they invited.

useCases.title: Set up a new brand for a website
useCases.text: Create a brand for a website, with a description. Each call creates a new record, so check the brand list first.

useCases.title: Change a campaign name or publish setting
useCases.text: Read the campaign first, then change its name or publish setting. Fields you leave out keep their current values.
